detail.title: 4CH Penta-brid 4K Mini 1U 1HDD WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR7104HE-4K-I3 4CH Penta-brid 4K Mini 1U 1HDD WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 4-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 4K@30fps Encoding Capability • Max. 8-ch IP Video Input (Up to 12MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 4-ch Perimeter Protection, 1-ch EPTZ, 1-ch Privacy Protection, 4-ch SMD, 4-ch AI Coding • 1 Bay. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Mode: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels(up to 12 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 20,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4 channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

AI Video Quality Analytics.AI Video Quality Analytics by Recorder: 4 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast levels, black and white

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 8 channels of IPC access 4 IP channels by default + 4 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) Incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 128 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, EPTZ, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, SMD, Perimeter Protection, QuickPick 2.0 and Privacy Protection cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Encode Enhancement disabled： Main stream: 4K@(1 fps–15 fps); 6 MP@(1fps–20 fps); 5 MP/4K-N/4 MP/3 MP/1080p/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 960H@(1 fps–15 fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Encode Enhancement enabled： Main stream: the 1st channel 4K@(1 fps–30 fps), others 4K@(1 fps–15 fps); 6 MP@(1 fps–20 fps); 5 MP/4K-N/4 MP/3 MP/1080p/720p/ 960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 960H@(1 fps–15 fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) *When Encode Enhancement is enabled, EPTZ, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, Perimeter Protection, QuickPick 2.0 and Privacy Protection cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Video Output: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable.
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; alarm; motion detection; intelligent; POS
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.Disk Interface: 1 SATA port. up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
Ports.USB: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 3.0 port)

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
